about: A meadow on a bright day, and the arena of Kitten Survivors. GENERATED — run `node tools/make-kitten-survivors-meadow.mjs` to rebuild it; edits made here are lost on the next run. The top of the ground is y = 0 and the field is 50 m across — the smallest the run survives, and near enough that a player reaches the wall. It draws three classes and nothing else: a 1.2 m cold wall that blocks, warm dark right-angled landmarks that name a place, and low ground-hue decoration that says nothing. The direction every other lane matches is kitten-survivors/art/world/bible.md. Enemies are not placed here: a survivor's crowd arrives on a clock, not out of a level file.
